title: Export Top-only product shipment unit summaries to Excel
description: A user downloads the current product ranking design with an optional exact-unit summary worksheet. Extend the existing Excel endpoint to rerun the current validated/authorized preview, append server-derived unit groups only when unit grouping is selected, and preserve detail column order and filters/date/Top context. Unit summary has ranking-bucket count, signed quantity subtotal for known units and explicit unknown quantity for blank units; all group context says current Top only. Text must be formula-safe, count and known quantity numeric, unknown quantity not zero; no money or cross-unit grand quantity. Designer Excel sends current GroupBy even without prior preview, preserves form state on errors and keeps none-group export compatible. Development only: reuse approved nondeleted StockOut/StockOutDetails evidence, the product-sales-ranking menu and fresh current-user SalespersonDataScopeService; retain existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Never widen ERP permissions or accept client rows/aggregates as authority. No arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct business/table writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, production deployment, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations or real browser acceptance. Keep unrelated work. Run focused in-memory unit/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Any external environment acceptance that cannot run must be marked environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Excel reruns authorization/validation and uses the same server-derived exact-unit groups for current filtered Top evidence; grouping none retains legacy detail workbook behavior.
Summary worksheet preserves stable unit order, typed count/known quantity, explicit unknown quantity, formula-safe labels and Top/filter/date context without money or cross-unit grand quantity.

Designer sends current GroupBy/filters/fields/date/Top on Excel downloads and surfaces errors; workbook tests cover hidden fields/negative values/unknown units/empty results/revoked permission and safe Release build/test passes.
